title: lathyrus laevigatus var. subalpinus
intro: Lathyrus laevigatus var. subalpinus, commonly known as the Alpine Pea, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of the Alpine Pea are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and high blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus laevigatus var. subalpinus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
